manual-accessibility-journeys.finding: This gate is satisfied for the AI proof-of-concept level, and explicitly NOT as WCAG conformance or human assurance. The project declares AI-agent-assisted keyboard, focus, semantics, reflow and visible-limitation journeys, and the accessibility statement states plainly that no independent human audit or representative assistive-technology test has been done and that no conformance is claimed (GAP-HUMAN-RESEARCH, RISK-015). This reviewer independently corroborated the assisted claims by loading the extracted landing page in a headless Chromium at 320 CSS pixels: exactly one H1; header, nav, main and footer landmarks present; a logical H1-H2-H2-H3-H3-H3-H2-H2 heading sequence with no skipped level; document lang=en; the first focusable element is the visible skip link 'Skip to the catalogue' targeting an existing #main; and no horizontal overflow at 320px. The single mobile axe 'incomplete' item was examined rather than treated silently: this reviewer ran axe-core 4.12.1 (the same engine version the evidence used) at 320px and reproduced exactly 0 violations and 1 incomplete. The incomplete is rule 'color-contrast' (serious) on #page-title and .lede, with axe's stated reason 'Element's background color could not be determined because it partially overlaps other elements'. This reviewer independently computed the actual contrast: #page-title is rgb(24,20,26) on the effective cream background rgb(247,244,236) = 16.56:1, and .lede is rgb(63,56,65) on the same = 10.31:1, both far exceeding WCAG AA (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large). The overlapping elements are decorative '.parcel' outline shapes whose background-color is rgba(0,0,0,0) (fully transparent), so they paint nothing behind the glyphs and cannot reduce contrast; a screenshot confirmed the dark heading is clearly legible on the cream field. The 'incomplete' is therefore benign axe uncertainty from bounding-box overlap of transparent decorations, not a contrast failure, and there are zero violations at every tested viewport. No critical or serious accessibility DEFECT was found.

security-critical-zero.finding: This is a bounded static-PoC review, not a penetration test.
